sections.heading: Context
lines: == W1c includes retained members (closed, archived, deleted) — a deleted Session keeps its journal head (state DELETED)
== preflight skips only members with no head and a retirement row; a deleted /2 Session has a head, so its profile is checked
++ plain W1b capture of the files/2 storage (st-b) still SEALS (main widened recovery to /1 and /2)
!! consequence: once any files/2 Session has existed in a storage, W1c cannot migrate that storage; I found no in-product way to clear the deleted member

note: Fail-closed and consistent with the stated scope. Whether a deleted /2 member should block forever is worth an explicit maintainer decision (or a README line).
